jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. This comes from a large sleeping guardian animal stirring in its dream, not from an attacker: the motion is soft, heavy and accidental, never sharp or aggressive. The effect is a slow snowfall of loose ledger pages drifting down and spreading wide across the whole cell. Frame 1 a few pages lift and hang. Frames 2-4 they multiply into a broad soft curtain of tumbling cream sheets, turning gently as they fall. Frame 6 the curtain is at its thickest and settles across the full width with a pale moonlit shimmer. Frames 7-8 the pages thin out and drift to rest. Palette: cream and bone-white paper, dusty lavender shadow, warm grey stone.
